ei.title: Size Reduction of Species Reflects Temperature Rise
ei.subject: 11월_2023 고2 모의고사
ei.lesson: Size Reduction of Species Reflects Temperature Rise

fullPassage:
The size of a species is not accidental. It’s a fine-tuned interaction between a species and the world it inhabits. Over large periods of time, size fluctuations have often signalled significant changes in the environment.

(A) But we are beginning to see changes in this trend. Scientists have discovered that many animals are shrinking. Around the world, species in every category have been found to be getting smaller, and one major cause appears to be the heat.

(B) Generally speaking, over the last five hundred million years, the trend has been towards animals getting larger. It’s particularly notable in marine animals, whose average body size has increased 150-fold in this time.

(C) Animals living in the Italian Alps, for example, have seen temperatures rise by three to four degrees Celsius since the 1980s. To avoid overheating, chamois goats now spend more of their days resting rather than searching for food, and as a result, in just a few decades, the new generations of chamois are 25 percent smaller.

To avoid overheating, chamois goats now spend more of their days (C)[resting / searching] rather than searching for food, and as a result, in just a few decades, the new generations of chamois are 25 percent smaller.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: ② (A) fine-tuned(미세하게 조정된) (B) shrinking(줄어드는) (C) resting(쉬는) — 원문 그대로

❌ ① accidental(우연한) - shrinking(줄어드는) - resting(쉬는) — (A) 오류
✅ ② fine-tuned(미세하게 조정된) - shrinking(줄어드는) - resting(쉬는) — 원문 그대로 ← 정답
❌ ③ fine-tuned(미세하게 조정된) - expanding(확장하는) - resting(쉬는) — (B) 오류

det.korean: smaller: 비교급 — getting + 비교급 구문
det.analysis: getting + 비교급: '점점 ~해지다' 구문이므로 small → smaller

questions.passage: The size of a species is not accidental. It's a fine-tuned __________(interact) between a species and the world it inhabits.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: interaction: 명사형 — a fine-tuned ___ (관사+형용사 뒤이므로 명사)
det.analysis: a fine-tuned + 명사 자리이므로 동사 interact → 명사 interaction

questions.passage: The size of a species is not accidental. It’s a fine-tuned interaction between a species and the world it inhabits. Over large periods of time, size fluctuations have often signalled significant changes in the environment. But we are beginning to see changes in this trend. Scientists have discovered that many animals are shrinking. Around the world, species in every category have been found to be __________, and one major cause appears to be the heat. Generally speaking, over the last five hundred million years, the trend has been towards animals getting larger. It’s particularly notable in marine animals, whose average body size has increased 150-fold in this time. Animals living in the Italian Alps, for example, have seen temperatures rise by three to four degrees Celsius since the 1980s. To avoid overheating, chamois goats now spend more of their days resting rather than searching for food, and as a result, in just a few decades, the new generations of chamois are 25 percent smaller.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸에 getting smaller(점점 작아지는)가 적절 — 모든 분류의 종이 점점 작아지고 있다
det.analysis:
✅ ① getting smaller: 점점 작아지는 — 원문 그대로 ← 정답
❌ ② larger in size: 크기가 더 큰 — 줄어드는 추세와 반대
❌ ③ more aggressive: 더 공격적인 — 문맥과 무관
❌ ④ moving faster: 더 빨리 이동하는 — 문맥과 무관

questions.passage: The size of a species is not accidental. It’s a fine-tuned interaction between a species and the world it inhabits. Over large periods of time, size fluctuations have often signalled significant changes in the environment. But we are beginning to see __________. Scientists have discovered that many animals are shrinking. Around the world, species in every category have been found to be getting smaller, and one major cause appears to be the heat. Generally speaking, over the last five hundred million years, the trend has been towards animals getting larger. It’s particularly notable in marine animals, whose average body size has increased 150-fold in this time. Animals living in the Italian Alps, for example, have seen temperatures rise by three to four degrees Celsius since the 1980s. To avoid overheating, chamois goats now spend more of their days resting rather than searching for food, and as a result, in just a few decades, the new generations of chamois are 25 percent smaller.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸에 changes in this trend(이 추세의 변화)가 적절 — 커지는 추세가 바뀌기 시작한다
det.analysis:
❌ ① animals getting larger: 동물이 커지는 — 이전 추세이지만 빈칸 문맥은 변화
✅ ② changes in this trend: 이 추세의 변화 — 원문 그대로 ← 정답
❌ ③ a rise in sea levels: 해수면 상승 — 본문에 언급 없음
❌ ④ shifts in migration patterns: 이주 패턴 변화 — 본문에 언급 없음
det.tip: changes in this trend = 이 추세의 변화
